rules: data.gov.uk reports the INSPIRE Index Polygons dataset last updated 2026-07-08
HM Land Registry National Polygon Service contains three licensed chargeable datasets
National Polygon dataset covers registered freehold and leasehold titles in England and Wales
every freehold or leasehold title in National Polygon has at least one index polygon
National Polygon Service reports more than 25 million titles and 28 million polygons
HM Land Registry index polygons in National Polygon are mapped against Ordnance Survey MasterMap
National Polygon dataset fields include shape polygon identification title number creation date update date version and record status
Title Descriptor dataset includes title number estate interest class of title registered status and record status
Title Number and UPRN Look Up dataset links HM Land Registry title numbers with UPRNs where available
UPRNs in the HM Land Registry lookup workflow are unique 12 digit identifiers created by local authorities and Ordnance Survey
National Polygon Service API access requires licence acceptance payment sign-in and an API key
HM Land Registry public-data guidance classifies INSPIRE Index Polygons under OGL while National Polygon Service is chargeable restricted-licence data
Planning Data title-boundary dataset currently reports 2,595,903 title boundaries
title-boundary dataset reports one data provider
title-boundary collector last ran on 2025-11-26
title-boundary dataset reports new data last found on 2025-11-26
title-boundary origin warns that some data was created by MHCLG and is being replaced with authoritative sources
title-boundary dataset is licensed under Open Government Licence v3.0
title-boundary attribution states Crown copyright and database rights 2026 reproduced with HM Land Registry permission
title-boundary polygon geometry is also attributed to Ordnance Survey Crown copyright and database rights 2026 number 100026316
live title-boundary entity pages identify the organisation as HM Land Registry
title-boundary entity schema exposes CURIE prefix reference dataset organisation start-date end-date entry-date typology geometry point and quality
title-boundary live entity geometry is supplied as WKT MULTIPOLYGON coordinates
title-boundary live entity point is supplied as WKT POINT coordinates
title-boundary entity pages provide GeoJSON download access
title-boundary dataset count and reference fields are support evidence only and do not replace exact current HMLR INSPIRE byte and containment provenance
Environment Agency replaced legacy Esri image services with WCS and WMS open-standard services
persistent LIDAR Composite DTM endpoints remove the annual year suffix so clients do not need annual endpoint changes
WMS presents summarised elevation while WCS provides elevation coverage values
WCS is an Open Geospatial Consortium standard for serving and retrieving multidimensional coverages
Environment Agency WCS can be used in QGIS and ESRI ArcGIS Desktop workflows
WCS requests raw pixel values such as elevation rather than rendered map colours
Environment Agency supports LIDAR Composite elevation models through WCS version 2.0.1
WCS responses for these elevation services are GeoTIFF rasters
GeoTIFF NoData pixels use numeric sentinel -3.4028235e+38 rather than a string
ArcGIS WCS does not support dataset statistics directly and uses stretch rendering
the published DTM 1m min max mean and standard deviation are rendering statistics and are not parcel elevation measurements
DSM includes heights of buildings vegetation vehicles and terrain whereas DTM removes surface objects to represent terrain
OS Downloads API can discover available OS OpenData products
OS Downloads API can automate retrieval of OS OpenData and Premium data packages
OS Downloads API supports product metadata and download links
OS Downloads API permits coverage-area requests where supported by the OpenData product
OS Downloads API does not provide access to previous releases of OpenData products
OS Terrain 50 per-tile metadata identifies the 10km National Grid tile reference
OS Terrain 50 metadata processing date is the tile creation date and not the real-world survey date
OS Terrain 50 metadata version number increments when a tile is published again
OS Terrain 50 metadata lineage distinguishes new imagery revised imagery and imagery checked with no change
OpenData download endpoint returns a download list or HTTP 307 redirect when redirect=true and exactly one match exists
